author: Zakami1
body:
A Mod called Prodigy banned my 4 accounts for no reason. I do not know what he/she has in mind on "Hacks" but i wasn't hacking.
I request this mod to be removed for banning my 4 accounts, for his/her "kind" of "hacking". I do not know how he/she saw i was "hacking" but i was not. This mod banned me for the nothing. I want justice for my accounts.
